name: Psycho Chameleon Bracket (Double #1 Star)
coverage: Chameleon Bracket (High-Low Double on Star X Receiver)

summary.motive: Eliminate the opponent’s primary star wide receiver using a Belichick-style bracket double-team disguised out of Flores’ signature 7-man psycho mug front.
summary.keyDefender: LCB & LURKER (Bracket tandem on #1 Star WR)
summary.whyItWorks: Quarterbacks under pressure instinctively look to their #1 playmaker on 1-on-1 matchups; bracketing that star eliminates the primary outlet while a 5-man rush gets home.
summary.failureMode: Secondary slot receiver winning instantly on an option route against single man coverage.

beats.title: Psycho Front Alignment
beats.text: Flores aligns 7 defenders at the line of scrimmage, disguising a Belichick-style double-team bracket coverage as an all-out house blitz.

beats.title: 5-Man Pressure Collapsing Edges
beats.text: At the snap, 5 rushers charge while LB_B2 drops and LURKER sprints toward the boundary. EDGE_L wins with speed around the left tackle.

beats.title: Star Receiver Bracketed Inside-Out
beats.text: The QB looks immediately to his #1 star wide receiver (X) expecting 1-on-1 zero coverage, only to find LCB outside and LURKER inside clamping the route in a vice.

beats.title: QB Forced to 3rd Read & Crushed
beats.text: Hesitating with his primary target erased, the QB is swallowed up by EDGE_L for a 2.4-second drive-ending sack.

relations.tell: Boundary corner plays outside leverage while safety brackets inside hip of star receiver in high-low double.
